title: Costs.
bodyText: Beginning July 1, 2023, all costs associated with the statewide parking for persons with disabilities program shall be paid using moneys appropriated from the accessible parking special account established pursuant to section 348F-7.5.
bodyHtml: [§291-60]  Costs.  Beginning July 1, 2023, all costs associated with the statewide parking for persons with disabilities program shall be paid using moneys appropriated from the accessible parking special account established pursuant to section 348F-7.5. [L 2022, c 161, §1]
